query:
SELECT 
  op.sku,
  op.productName,
  op.color,
  MONTH(o.deliveryDate) as month,
  SUM(op.quantity) as qty
FROM orderProducts op
JOIN orders o ON op.orderId = o.id
WHERE op.sku IN ('UP920A-VC', 'UP920A-LG', 'UP920PLUS-BB', 'UP920PLUS-BP')
  AND o.deliveryDate IS NOT NULL
  AND YEAR(o.deliveryDate) = 2026
GROUP BY op.sku, op.productName, op.color, MONTH(o.deliveryDate)
ORDER BY op.sku, month;
